matrix_note: One-API v0.6.10 has no OpenAI-Responses relay mode and its Cohere channel emits the Cohere v1 /v1/chat shape, not the v2 dialect this suite probes (relay/channeltype/define.go, relay/adaptor/cohere/adaptor.go GetRequestURL); those cells are grey by that capability limit
name: one-api
untestable_note: This harness has not established that One-API routes its anthropic or gemini channels, so those cells are recorded untestable rather than failed. The channels are created by gateways/one-api/commands (types 14 and 24, models claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 and gemini-1.5-pro, base_url on the mock) and the POSTs succeed, but a relay request for either model answers HTTP 503 with One-API's own message that there is no available channel for it under group 'default'. That was true in all eight runs of 2026-07-27/28, including the oldest engine, so it is not a regression in either One-API or this harness - it is a configuration we have not got right. Grading it as a gateway failure would publish a red One-API may not have earned; the openai lane is unaffected and is measured normally. Asked upstream at katanemo/plano#1000's sibling thread and will be re-declared the moment the correct channel setup is known.
